# EFF Diceware Long Wordlist

Arcade Box bundles the EFF Diceware Long Wordlist, created by Joseph Bonneau and the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF), to generate local passphrases.

- Source: [EFF Dice-Generated Passphrases](https://www.eff.org/dice)
- List file: [eff_large_wordlist.txt](https://www.eff.org/files/2016/07/18/eff_large_wordlist.txt)
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 United States](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/)
- License copy: [CC-BY-3.0-US.html](CC-BY-3.0-US.html)
- Changes: none; the original tab-separated word list is bundled unchanged.

The EFF describes its long wordlist as 7,776 entries (six choices per die across five dice) and recommends at least six independently selected words for typical use. Arcade Box selects each word independently and uniformly with its operating system-backed cryptographic random generator.
